question_summary: Request approval to substitute a tankless water heater for the specified storage-type unit in Spec Section 22 34 00 prior to material order and fixture rough-in.
proposed_solution: Approve substituting a tankless water heater in lieu of the specified storage-type unit; change is cost-neutral and will not affect the domestic water pressure test date.
deadline_text: A response by the end of the day
routing_rationale: As this is a plumbing equipment substitution governed by Section 22 34 00, the Plumbing/Fire Protection Engineer should evaluate capacity, venting/piping, and code compliance.
